system.flavor:
Turn a gout of flame into a cold wind, a lightning strike into a hard shove, or a splash of acid into a harmless spray before it reaches one person. Soften it on the way.

Not enough to shield a crowd or stop a blow that is not magical.

body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Fire, Cold, Lightning, Acid, Force or Arcane Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Change that Damage to another listed type and reduce it by 1. Conditions do not change.

surges.html: The target also resists 1 unit of forced movement from the Action.
